items.name: voice/en/m06_arrival/moon
items.text: The Moon, three days out. The port declared Tern's ship impounded before the engines were cold. Tern put us out through the cargo lock and stayed with the passengers.
items.title: Port of Entry: arrival

items.name: voice/en/m06_arrival/port
items.text: Our neighbours are across the crater. Get through customs.
items.title: Port of Entry: customs

items.name: voice/en/l06_l07/transit
items.text: The transit tunnel leads toward the lunar town. Tern and the passengers remain with the impounded ship. The custody depot stands across the crater.
items.title: Port of Entry: transit
